description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages a fragment, handles menu options for toggling a log view, and initializes logging components for on-screen log display.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages UI fragments, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the main fragment if not restoring from saved state.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling visibility and title of the log toggle item based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling the log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment for on-screen logs.
